source.content: public class CurrentBaseProcess001Plugin implements Process.Plugin { public Process.PluginDescribeResult describe() { return new Process.PluginDescribeResult(); } public Process.PluginResult invoke(Process.PluginRequest request) { return null; } } @isTest private class CurrentBaseProcess001Test { @isTest static void processShapes() { Process.ParameterType parameterType = Process.ParameterType.STRING; System.assertEquals(parameterType, Process.ParameterType.valueOf('STRING')); System.assert(parameterType.equals(Process.ParameterType.STRING)); System.assertNotEquals(null, parameterType.hashCode()); System.assert(parameterType.ordinal() >= 0); System.assert(Process.ParameterType.values().size() > 0); Process.Plugin plugin = new CurrentBaseProcess001Plugin(); System.assertNotEquals(null, plugin); Process.PluginDescribeResult describe = new Process.PluginDescribeResult(); describe.name = 'Current base'; describe.description = 'Local'; describe.tag = 'api67'; Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter input = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter('recordId', 'Record Id', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.ID, true); input.Name = 'recordId'; input.Description = 'Record Id'; input.Required = true; Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter output = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter('message', 'Message', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING); output.Name = 'message'; output.Description = 'Message'; describe.inputParameters = new List<Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter>{input}; describe.outputParameters = new List<Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter>{output}; System.assertEquals('Current base', describe.name); System.assertEquals('Local', describe.description); System.assertEquals('api67', describe.tag); System.assertEquals('recordId', input.Name); System.assertEquals('Record Id', input.Description); System.assertEquals(true, input.Required); System.assertEquals('message', output.Name); System.assertEquals('Message', output.Description); Process.SparkPlugDescribeResult spark = new Process.SparkPlugDescribeResult(); spark.name = 'Spark'; spark.inputParameters = new List<Process.SparkPlugParameter>(); spark.outputParameters = new List<Process.SparkPlugParameter>(); Process.SparkPlugDescribeResult sparkClone = (Process.SparkPlugDescribeResult)spark.clone(); System.assertEquals('Spark', spark.name); System.assertEquals(0, spark.inputParameters.size()); System.assertEquals(0, spark.outputParameters.size()); System.assertEquals('Spark', sparkClone.name); } }
